content: react-native-google-mobile-ads 16.5.0 (latest): works on old AND new architecture (Android still uses interop for most formats; iOS fully migrated). Config plugin = package itself (app.plugin.js); plugin props (v16.5.0 type defs): androidAppId, iosAppId, delayAppMeasurementInit, optimizeInitialization, optimizeAdLoading, skAdNetworkItems, userTrackingUsageDescription (string - old userTrackingPermission boolean is gone; omit to skip ATT). UMP built in: import { AdsConsent, AdsConsentStatus } - gatherConsent(), requestInfoUpdate(), getConsentInfo().canRequestAds. childDirectedTreatment/maxAdContentRating are RUNTIME RequestConfiguration, NOT plugin props.
